storyCards.headline: Sing: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
My Chemical Romance's "Sing" reached #58 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #58 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 17 weeks on the chart.

Sing was released in 2010.

Album: Danger Days: The True Lives Of The Fabulous Killjoys (2010).
